verdict.rationale: Letta documents a managed cloud sandbox where web-app agents run without local setup, which isolates tool execution from your machine. Its headless --ephemeral flag runs one-shot tasks without creating or persisting agent state, and /fork branches a conversation without changing the original. These are execution isolation and non-persistence, not a documented test or staging environment separated from production data, so delivery is only partial. Missing for 10: an explicit test/staging environment, documented separation of sandbox data from production data, guarantees that ephemeral or sandboxed runs cannot reach real resources, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: The web app uses a managed cloud sandbox by default, so you can start without configuring a computer.
Use --ephemeral to run a one-shot task without creating, resuming, or persisting an agent, memory blocks, or MemFS
The new conversation can take a different direction without changing the original thread
